style: Entire website printed on tactile fibrous paper: cobalt ink, warm ivory stock, visible pulp and fibres, dry ink wear, torn sheet edges, layered paper inserts and halftone cutouts.

brand.name: PACT
brand.expansion: Protocol for Agent Coordination and Tasks
brand.mark: A single continuous ivory paper sticker: monochrome circle, upright triangle and square in a horizontal row, with a large bold PACT wordmark below.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: final PACT editorial paper sticker logo, one single die-cut paper piece, transparent background.
Edit target: the attached PACT logo.
Primary request: change the symbol plaque from VERTICAL to HORIZONTAL, and unite the symbol plaque and the PACT lettering into ONE continuous paper sticker.
Layout: top row contains exactly three symbols horizontally, ordered left-to-right CIRCLE, upright TRIANGLE, upright SQUARE. All three are evenly spaced, equal optical size, with their centers aligned on the same horizontal centerline. Enclose the row in one wide low rounded-rectangle ink outline. Directly beneath it, the exact large uppercase word "PACT" is centered, bold and very legible.
CRITICAL single-piece sticker: the ivory paper behind the top symbol row and behind the PACT word must be physically ONE connected continuous block. No transparent gap, no seam, no overlapping pieces, no floating separate wordmark. A single compact outer torn-paper contour encloses the entire composition. The connecting ivory area between symbol row and PACT is completely opaque and uninterrupted.
Composition: compact near-square logo badge, slightly wider than tall, overall aspect approximately 1.15:1. Tight balanced spacing, symbol row and wordmark similar widths. Perfectly upright front view, not rotated. Whole logo visible with small 4% outside margins, no large empty canvas.
Preserve: the existing beautiful bold slab-serif PACT letterforms, warm ivory #eee7d7 fibrous paper, deep green-black #122923 worn ink, screenprint halftone dots, restrained dry print texture and handmade torn edge. The symbols remain upright despite the plaque becoming horizontal. Retain exactly these four letters once.
Background: real alpha transparency OUTSIDE the one paper sticker only; the interior paper remains completely opaque.
Avoid: vertical stacking of the three shapes, tilted triangle, multiple stickers, white gap between elements, extra words, period after PACT, robot, hands, realistic 3D, bevel, cast shadow, glow, colored rectangular backdrop, watermark.

assets.usage: Shared physical paper stock for every page surface, multiplied with ivory, cobalt and ink backgrounds at a 640px tile size.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: seamless neutral paper material texture tile for a whole website, NOT a mockup or illustration.
Primary request: create a high-resolution, flat, evenly lit macro scan of tactile uncoated handmade editorial paper, suitable for repeating as a CSS background and tinting with cobalt ink or warm ivory.
Composition: fill the entire square image edge to edge with the SAME paper material. No objects, no border, no torn outer edge, no text, no symbols. All edges must match smoothly for a seamless repeating tile, with no obvious center or directional lighting.
Material: real archival rag paper, plentiful fine irregular visible fibers, tiny short threads, scattered grey and dark brown pinprick flecks, subtle pulp clusters, tiny scratches and authentic dry uneven grain. Visibly tactile and fibrous at normal webpage scale. Restrained random natural imperfections distributed evenly, no large stains or folds.
Color palette: almost white neutral warm grey base, approximately #f3f1e9, with clearly visible delicate mid-grey and muted brown fibers and speckles. Low overall contrast to preserve text readability, but distinguishable fibers rather than an almost-flat blank image.
Style/medium: high quality optical scan of physical paper. Perfectly flat frontal scan, no perspective, no 3D render, no vignette, no shiny surfaces, no gradients, no lighting variation. Square format.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: editorial website hero illustration, transparent paper collage cutout.
Primary request: redraw the PACT robot in Image 1 using exactly the vintage printed editorial visual language of Image 2.
Input images: Image 1 is the subject and identity reference; Image 2 is the exclusive style and material reference.
Subject: preserve the friendly rectangular robot head, two vertical eye lights, one central wheel, two arms, one hand holding a sheet with a checkmark, the other joining two cables between two small server boxes left and right. Keep every object fully visible. Make the composition more compact vertically, with the head close to the top of the illustration.
Style/medium: sophisticated editorial screenprint collage, a 1960s newspaper engraving reproduced with large irregular halftone dots, almost-black ink #102923 on warm ivory paper #eee5d2. Strong contrast, bold simplified masses, rough offset printing, visible worn fibers, speckled ink, torn paper edges. Match the tiger reference's coarse photographic halftone density and authentic uneven print texture.
Color palette: ivory paper and near-black ink with sparing cobalt blue #0864ca accents on eyes, cables and checkmark. No cyan.
Composition/framing: a single unified irregular torn ivory paper silhouette around the entire robot and two servers, compact centered square, generous paper border but minimal empty outer margin, fully transparent outside the torn paper silhouette. The cutout will be placed on a cobalt blue webpage.
Constraints: recognizable same robot and action as Image 1, no tiger, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no realistic 3D render, no glossy surfaces, no digital gradients, no thin cartoon outlines, no black or blue rectangular background. Real alpha transparency outside the torn-paper cutout.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: second editorial illustration for the PACT landing page, transparent paper collage cutout.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and subject reference (robot comparing geometric shapes); Image 2 is the exclusive editorial print style reference (tiger); Image 3 is the approved PACT hero illustration for character and print continuity.
Primary request: redraw Image 1 using the exact coarse vintage halftone newspaper screenprint collage style of Images 2 and 3. Preserve the same friendly rectangular-headed single-wheel robot, two vertical eyes, both arms, one hand holding a small sheet with three shapes circle triangle square, and a matching tall template board with the same three shapes on the right. Show the entire subject with no cropped objects.
Style/medium: near-black #102923 printed engraving and coarse irregular halftone dots on warm ivory #eee5d2 torn paper, authentic imperfect ink coverage, distressed paper fibers, bold high-contrast forms. Small cobalt #0864ca accents on robot eyes and geometric shapes. Match Image 3's robot character, silhouette, and ink density.
Composition/framing: compact landscape, isolated single irregular torn paper silhouette around robot and template board. Thin rough ivory paper margin. Fully transparent outside the torn paper edges.
Constraints: no words, no text, no watermarks, no tiger, no new objects, no 3D rendering, no glossy shading, no gradients, no fine comic outlines, NO cast shadow, NO glow, NO halo, NO colored or black background. Real alpha transparency outside the cut paper.
